ana: Proposal — phased 'version leash' for promotes. Short summary: pin a new model behind a small traffic leash and a soft backstop that auto-fails the promote if slice deltas exceed thresholds. Goal is to catch long-doc / rerank regressions and int4 edge cases before wide rollout. Thoughts?

kai: Love the name. Key metrics to watch: mrr_longdoc, rerank_precision@10, hallucination_rate, and p95 latency. How do you want to compute the delta window? 1h rolling vs baseline?

dmitri: My suggestion: delta = (new - control)/control with bootstrap CI. Backstop fires if lower CI for mrr_longdoc < -0.02 OR hallucination_rate increase > 0.01. Also require min_samples >= 500 in the window to avoid noise.

olivia: FWIW we've seen int4 brings subtle truncation at seqlen ~1024 on certain prompts. For the leash create a seqlen slice (>=1024) with a tighter MRR threshold. Also KV warmup (warmup_window=600s) reduced those truncation cases in staging.

eva: Draft config for the leash/backstop (quick):
```
leash: { pct: 0.05, ramp_steps: 6, step_interval_s: 600 }
backstop: {
  metrics: ["mrr_longdoc", "hallucination_rate"],
  mrr_delta_threshold: -0.02,
  hall_rate_threshold: 0.01,
  min_samples: 500,
  ci_alpha: 0.05
}
fallback_action: "route:pin-to-stable"
```
This can be wired into the promote pipeline so the route manager will auto-pin on backstop.

ci-bot: smoke-run: v2q-int4 @ 5% leash -> mrr_longdoc delta = -1.7% (p=0.03), hallucination_rate +0.6%, n=620. Suggest running targeted slice eval+rerank harness. :warning:

ana: (typo) Ana: Thanks — that's borderline. With our backstop thresholds this would trigger a soft-fail. Recommendation: pause ramp, run targeted longdoc + rerank evaluation and a larger shadow run for rerank candidates.

kai: I'll kick off gated-eval with the seqlen>=1024 slice and rerank harness. ETA ~2h.

dmitri: I'll add the bootstrap CI routine into the promote job and bump the min_samples guard to 1k for final promotion.

olivia: I'll add KV warmup to the deploy template and enable p95 tail alerts for the leash window.

ana: Plan: pause rake (ramp), run evals, reconvene in ~3h in #eng-ml with results. Thanks all :thumbsup:
